question: Which initiative is intended to encourage domestic manufacturing and attract foreign investment?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Make in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Make in India** is a flagship initiative launched by the **Government of India** on **25th September 2014**.
 
• This program aims to transform India into a **global manufacturing hub**.
 
• It encourages both **domestic manufacturing** and attracts **foreign direct investment (FDI)** into the country.
 
• The initiative focuses on creating job opportunities and enhancing the **ease of doing business**.
